name: B10-0424/2026 – After § 7 – Am 18
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the need for an EU strategy to counter Islamist entryism and the influence of the Muslim Brotherhood network
part_text: 7a. Pays tribute to all victims of Islamist terrorism and expresses its full support for their families, as well as for all whistleblowers, intellectuals, journalists, artists and political figures directly threatened by Islamist movements; commends the courage of all those who have broken with Islamist movements or who publicly denounce Islamist ideology despite threats to their safety;
